title: Pure Machina
summary: Machina cards only, with generic Machine Xyz Monsters, Links and staples. Machina is an EARTH Machine toolbox that destroys its own monsters to swap them for bigger ones. Machina Gearframe searches a Machina, and Machina Redeployment searches two. Machina Air Raider and Machina Irradiator discard a Machina to summon themselves, then destroy one of your Machines to bring a different Machina from the Deck or GY. Machina Fortress summons itself by discarding Machines and punishes targeting. Machina Citadel wipes their weaker monsters and returns when your EARTH Machines fall. Machina Ruinforce, the newest card, summons itself from the GY by banishing Machines with 12 or more Levels. In the Battle Phase it negates any activation and halves their LP. Machina Unclaspare limits you to Machines for the turn.
